limitations: Time budgets, frequency labels and the 21-workday calculation base are examples from one organization-specific operating model, not universal standards.

References to legal acts and dates are not independently verified by this source record; legal applicability must be checked against official current texts.
The 16 HACCP work instructions are listed by title/code, but individual approved source files are not attached or independently recovered.
Business identifiers, personal contacts and exact establishment address are intentionally excluded from generalized knowledge.
